permission: Gary gave permission to add these portraits to Dune Zone on Discord on 7 November 2026 ("ye you can throw them on there, more stuff for the community the better"). Norbert relayed it and asked for them to be added.
originals: Gary's portraits are his own AI-generated characters, except marked-leader and resolute-officer, which he based on characters from Dune: Awakening (Funcom). Norbert chose to include both on 7 November 2026.
generation: Built-in imagegen style transfer of Gary's transparent originals, with three original GF9 leader portraits as style references, asking for the loose pen lines and colour washes of the GF9 leaders.
processing: The transparent redraw is composited onto the GF9 leader tan without cropping, then resized with Pillow Lanczos to a lossless RGB PNG.

corrections.skeptical-officer: A localized imagegen edit removed a duplicated pupil in her right eye; everything else is unchanged.

houses: Gary drew these portraits as leaders for the Dune: Awakening Landsraad houses Mikarrol and Lindaren; each portrait's folder names its house.
source: Gary's transparent PNG portraits, shared on Discord on 7 November 2026 and relayed by Norbert; Gary's files are not stored in this repository.
styleReferences: Three original GF9 leader portraits, the same references used for the Hivers set.
